summary.zh: 正式语气指在学术写作和考试写作中使用客观、准确、克制且专业的语言表达观点。对于准备 PTE Academic 和 IELTS 的中国英语学习者来说，Formal Tone 能帮助文章显得更学术、更有逻辑，也能减少口语化、情绪化和绝对化表达。正式语气通常避免 contractions、slang、personal language、emotional adjectives 和 vague words，并倾向使用名词化结构、被动语态、hedging language、学术动词和清晰的逻辑连接。

structure.formula: Formal Tone = 客观表达 + 精准词汇 + 学术句式 + 适度谨慎 + 避免口语化
structure.explanation: 正式语气并不是把句子写得复杂，而是让表达更符合学术场景。写作时应减少 I, you, we 等个人化表达，避免 a lot of, kids, stuff, really, very bad 等口语或模糊词汇；同时使用 more precise vocabulary，例如 significant, considerable, individuals, factors, consequences。正式写作还常使用 passive voice、nominalisation、impersonal structures 和 hedging expressions，使论述更客观、更符合 PTE Write Essay 与 IELTS Writing Task 2 的评分要求。

examples.en: Informal: I think online learning is really good for students.
examples.zh: 非正式：我认为在线学习对学生真的很好。

examples.en: Formal: Online learning can provide students with flexible access to educational resources.
examples.zh: 正式：在线学习能够为学生提供灵活获取教育资源的机会。

examples.en: Informal: People get a lot of problems because of pollution.
examples.zh: 非正式：人们因为污染遇到很多问题。

examples.en: Formal: Pollution may lead to a range of public health and environmental challenges.
examples.zh: 正式：污染可能导致一系列公共健康和环境方面的挑战。

usage_scenarios.title: 表达观点时保持客观
usage_scenarios.description: 在 IELTS Writing Task 2 和 PTE Write Essay 中，考生需要提出立场，但不应过度依赖 I think 或 I believe。更正式的方式是使用 impersonal structures 或 objective verbs，让观点看起来更有学术依据。

examples.en: It can be argued that governments should invest more in renewable energy.
examples.zh: 可以认为，政府应在可再生能源方面投入更多资金。

examples.en: This essay will discuss the reasons why urbanisation has increased housing pressure.
examples.zh: 本文将讨论城市化为何加剧住房压力。

usage_scenarios.title: 描述原因、结果和影响
usage_scenarios.description: 正式写作中，原因和结果需要用准确的逻辑动词或短语表达，例如 contribute to, result in, lead to, be associated with。避免简单重复 because 或 so。

examples.en: Excessive screen time may contribute to reduced concentration among adolescents.
examples.zh: 过度使用电子屏幕可能导致青少年注意力下降。

examples.en: The decline in public transport usage has resulted in heavier traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 公共交通使用率下降已经导致更严重的交通拥堵。

usage_scenarios.title: 比较不同观点
usage_scenarios.description: 学术写作经常要求比较观点。正式语气应使用 balanced language，避免说某一方 completely wrong。可使用 while, whereas, although, from another perspective 等结构。

examples.en: While technology improves workplace efficiency, it may also reduce certain employment opportunities.
examples.zh: 尽管科技提高了工作效率，它也可能减少某些就业机会。

examples.en: Whereas some individuals prioritise economic growth, others emphasise environmental protection.
examples.zh: 有些人优先考虑经济增长，而另一些人则强调环境保护。

usage_scenarios.title: 提出解决方案
usage_scenarios.description: 在解决问题类作文中，应避免口语化命令，如 people must do this。更正式的表达可以使用 should be encouraged to, measures should be implemented, it is essential to。

examples.en: Effective measures should be implemented to reduce food waste in urban communities.
examples.zh: 应采取有效措施来减少城市社区中的食物浪费。

examples.en: Individuals should be encouraged to adopt more sustainable consumption habits.
examples.zh: 应鼓励个人采取更可持续的消费习惯。

common_mistakes.wrong: I think the government should give people a lot of money because life is very hard.
common_mistakes.correct: It can be argued that the government should provide greater financial support, as many citizens face considerable living pressures.
common_mistakes.explanation: 错误句中过度使用 I think, a lot of, very hard，语气口语化且不够精确。正式表达应减少个人化开头，使用 financial support, considerable living pressures 等更学术的词汇。

common_mistakes.wrong: Kids nowadays are addicted to phones, and this is super bad.
common_mistakes.correct: Many children today are heavily dependent on mobile devices, which may have negative effects on their cognitive and social development.
common_mistakes.explanation: kids 和 super bad 属于口语表达，不适合学术写作。children, mobile devices, negative effects, cognitive and social development 更正式、更具体。

common_mistakes.wrong: You can see that pollution is everywhere.
common_mistakes.correct: It is evident that pollution has become a widespread environmental issue.
common_mistakes.explanation: You can see that 是直接对读者说话，学术写作中应避免第二人称 you。It is evident that 是更客观的 academic expression。

common_mistakes.wrong: The internet is good and bad, so we should use it carefully.
common_mistakes.correct: The internet offers substantial benefits, although its potential risks require careful management.
common_mistakes.explanation: good and bad 过于简单，so 连接逻辑较弱。正式写作应使用 benefits, potential risks, require careful management 等更准确的表达。

common_mistakes.wrong: Students don't have enough time to finish homework.
common_mistakes.correct: Students do not have sufficient time to complete their assignments.
common_mistakes.explanation: 正式写作中应避免 contractions，如 don't 应写成 do not。homework 可根据语境替换为 assignments，使表达更学术。

common_mistakes.wrong: This problem is getting bigger and bigger.
common_mistakes.correct: This problem has become increasingly serious.
common_mistakes.explanation: bigger and bigger 口语化且不精确。increasingly serious 更符合正式语气，也常用于 PTE 和 IELTS 写作。

pte_usage.description: Formal Tone 在 PTE Academic 的写作评分中非常重要，尤其影响 Written Discourse、Grammar 和 Vocabulary。Write Essay 需要考生用正式、连贯、客观的语言展开论证；Summarize Written Text 也要求压缩原文信息时保持学术语气，避免主观评价和口语化表达。PTE 写作通常不需要文学化语言，而需要准确、清晰、逻辑性强的 academic English。
sections: Reading and Writing: Fill in the Blanks

academic_patterns.pattern: It can be argued that + clause
There is growing evidence that + clause
This issue is closely associated with + noun phrase
A key factor contributing to + noun phrase + is + noun phrase
academic_patterns.translation: 导致……的一个关键因素是……

academic_patterns.pattern: The extent to which + clause + remains a matter of debate
academic_patterns.translation: ……的程度仍然是一个有争议的问题

academic_patterns.pattern: Measures should be taken to + verb phrase
This may have significant implications for + noun phrase
academic_patterns.translation: 这可能对……产生重要影响

academic_patterns.pattern: Although + clause, it is important to recognise that + clause
academic_patterns.translation: 尽管……，但重要的是要认识到……

academic_patterns.pattern: The primary concern is not + noun phrase, but rather + noun phrase

ai_tips: 检查作文时，优先替换口语词汇，例如把 a lot of 改为 numerous, considerable 或 a significant amount of。
避免频繁使用 I think。议论文中可使用 It can be argued that, It is evident that 或 This suggests that。
不要为了正式而写过长的句子。PTE 写作更重视清晰度、语法准确性和逻辑连贯。
使用 hedging language，如 may, can, tend to, is likely to，避免过度绝对化表达。
正式语气不等于堆砌高级词汇。只有在语义准确的情况下，academic vocabulary 才能提高表达质量。

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为正式语气：I think social media is really bad for young people.
practice_questions.answer: It can be argued that social media may have negative effects on young people.

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为正式语气：A lot of people don't like living in big cities because it is too noisy.
practice_questions.answer: Many individuals are reluctant to live in large cities because of excessive noise pollution.

practice_questions.question: 选择更正式的表达：A. kids B. children
practice_questions.answer: B. children。children 比 kids 更适合学术写作。

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为正式语气：You can see that climate change is a big problem.
practice_questions.answer: It is evident that climate change is a major global challenge.

practice_questions.question: 将句子改写为正式语气：The government must fix this problem fast.
practice_questions.answer: The government should implement effective measures to address this issue promptly.

practice_questions.question: 指出下列句子的问题：Students can't get good jobs because the economy is bad.
practice_questions.answer: 问题包括 contraction can't、表达 good jobs 和 bad 过于简单。可改为：Students may find it difficult to obtain stable employment due to unfavourable economic conditions.

practice_questions.question: 用正式语气完成句子：From a long-term perspective, online education...
practice_questions.answer: From a long-term perspective, online education may expand access to learning opportunities and reduce geographical barriers.

practice_questions.question: 将口语表达 stuff 替换为一个更正式的词，并造句。
practice_questions.answer: 可替换为 materials, resources 或 factors。例句：Students should have access to sufficient learning resources.
